The full t=3 error-weight law at the optimally reconstructible view count gives exact finite-block reliability, a first unreported k=8 benchmark, closed formulas for all longer blocks, sharp maximum wrong-coordinate phase transitions (4,3,2), and a uniform-view large-deviation exponent.
